item.title: Power restored to some, in Wake County, others still in the dark Monday night, Duke Energy reports
item.description: More than 1,000 people in the north Raleigh area have been affected by power outages. In the Lead Mine road area Duke Energy shows 695 people are without power. Further north along Six Forks Road at the Newton Road intersection, 819 people are without power. In southern Wake County along Battle Bridge Road and into the Battleridge North area, Duke Energy shows more than 1,000 people. No cause is listed for outage at this time, but crews are on scene.
